purpose: Evidence for a future persistence cost optimization SDD; analysis of the unchanged controlled reference, not an optimization or a new baseline

measuredCode.scope: Tracked and new runtime, benchmark, harness, source and package files; excludes generated reference artifacts

scope.arrivals: All projected sessions at the start of the window

assumptions.source: Explicit pre-deployment workload hypotheses, not measured cloud durations or an invoice. Change these inputs to cost another workload.

placement.pubsub: us-central1, no cross-region subscriptions/backlog over one day

assumptions.compute: gcfv2 request-based billing, 100ms increments, serial requests in separate instances; assigned CPU/RAM from endpoint/defaults; cold/startup allocation added separately, minInstances=0. This does not assert the deployed concurrency or actual cold rate.
assumptions.retention: Sessions projected at the start of a 30-day window; retained documents and RTDB nodes stay until window end. No TTL is invented. Temporary Firestore inventory uses observed emulator residency including virtual waits. Config/log documents allocated once per experiment/window.
assumptions.network: Provider and public HTTP content observed; TLS/protocol uplift assumed. RTDB 512 response bytes per SDK exchange plus 3500 TLS bytes per connection, including a backend connection per invocation with RTDB operations. Event payloads add 1024 envelope bytes, one publication and each delivery; model one message/request, minimum 1KiB. Eventarc Google-source rate zero, Pub/Sub charged separately.
assumptions.logs: Cloud Logging bytes assumed per invocation, with 30-day retention. Firestore logs/{experimentID} writes/storage are measured separately.
exclusions: Existing provider subscription/storage plan (Drive, Dropbox or OSF); bytes/files and API calls reported, no zero-priced unlimited storage assumed
Publication/build/deployment/artifact storage and SDK/browser downloads: preparation outside runtime workload
Actual billing account quotas, tax, discounts, currency conversion and unrelated project workloads
Browser device CPU/storage and benchmark infrastructure: not Cloud Functions resources

run.scope: us-central1 request-based billing, default consumption model

tasks.scope: Gross operation price, before account-wide free quota

storage.scope: nam5 standard storage, USD 0.18 per GiB-month; monthly storage representation includes indexes

firebase.scope: Realtime Database Blaze storage and downloads, gross pre-quota

eventarc.scope: Standard Google-source events; Pub/Sub transport charged separately

pubsub.scope: Message Delivery Basic USD40/TiB, gross before account quota

network.scope: Premium egress from US to North America; gross tiers before shared free quota

firestore-network.scope: Traffic within a region or regions of the same multi-region

logging.scope: USD0.50/GiB ingestion, includes first 30 retention days, gross before shared free allotment

scheduler.scope: Gross job-day price, including paused jobs

modelLimitations.finding: The model expands maps to leaves and arrays to distinct elements, whereas current automatic-index documentation also describes whole-map and whole-array ascending/descending indexes. Recorded storage quantities are results of this model, not an independently measured deployed-index footprint.

shortQuotes: One collection-scope ascending index for the whole map value
One collection-scope ascending index for the whole array value

modelLimitations.finding: documentStorage throws when fieldOverrides is nonempty; exemptions cannot yet be compared with this model.
modelLimitations.modelProbeError: Storage model does not support field overrides yet

modelLimitations.finding: Operation counts and content bytes are observed; CPU/RAM allocation, cold starts, protocol/TLS, and retained storage representation use declared hypotheses. Changes in hypotheses are not product savings.
